settings.custom_liquid:
<style>
  /* Maak deze Custom Liquid section zelf “ruimte-loos” */
  #shopify-section-{{ section.id }}{
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    height: 0 !important;
    min-height: 0 !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
  }

  :root{
    --rxl-blue:#003878;
    --rxl-orange:#ff7300;
    --rxl-btn:44px;
    --rxl-icon:28px;
    --rxl-gap:0px;        /* <-- GEEN ruimte */
    --rxl-stroke:2px;
  }

  /* Buttons */
  .header-actions__action,
  .account-button,
  .header-actions__cart-icon{
    width: var(--rxl-btn) !important;
    height: var(--rxl-btn) !important;
    display: inline-flex !important;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    background: transparent !important;
    border: 0 !important;
    line-height: 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    position: relative;
  }

  /* Spacing alleen tussen icons (nu 0) */
  .header-actions__action + .account-button,
  .header-actions__action + .header-actions__cart-icon,
  .account-button + .header-actions__cart-icon{
    margin-left: var(--rxl-gap) !important;
  }

  /* SVG maat */
  .header-actions__action svg,
  .account-button svg,
  .header-actions__cart-icon svg{
    width: var(--rxl-icon) !important;
    height: var(--rxl-icon) !important;
    display: block;
  }

  /* Pak ALLE svg elements mee (account icon gebruikt vaak circle/line/etc) */
  .header-actions__action svg *,
  .account-button svg *,
  .header-actions__cart-icon svg *{
    fill: none !important;
    stroke: var(--rxl-blue) !important;
    stroke-width: var(--rxl-stroke) !important;
    stroke-linecap: round;
    stroke-linejoin: round;
    vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
    transition: stroke .15s ease-in-out;
  }

  /* Account icoon lijkt vaak “groter” door viewBox -> kleine correctie */
  .account-button svg{
    transform: scale(0.90);
    transform-origin: 50% 50%;
  }

  /* Hover */
  .header-actions__action:hover svg *,
  .account-button:hover svg *,
  .header-actions__cart-icon:hover svg *{
    stroke: var(--rxl-orange) !important;
  }

  /* Cart bubble */
  .cart-bubble{
    position: absolute;
    top: 5px;
    right: 5px;
    background-color: var(--rxl-orange) !important;
  }
</style>
